name: Rating input
summary: A star rating made of radio buttons, for reviews and feedback forms.
description:
Use it to ask for a score from 1 to 5. To show a fixed score, use the read-only .v-rating instead.

It is a <fieldset> of radio buttons with a legend, drawn as stars: the arrow keys, required, form submission and reset all come from the browser, and it needs no JS. Every star up to the checked one fills, and hovering previews a choice.

classes.name: v-rating-input
classes.description: The <fieldset>. Add .v-fieldset-plain and a .v-legend for the question.

classes.name: v-rating-input-star
classes.description: One <label> holding a visually hidden radio, the star icon and the words for screen readers.

classes.name: v-rating-input-sm
classes.description: Smaller stars, for a compact form.

states.description: On a radio: the current score. Stars up to it fill.
On the first radio: the form will not submit without a score.
On the fieldset: dims the stars and blocks changes.

keyboard.action: Moves into the group, onto the checked star (or the first).
Changes the score by one, as in any radio group (flipped in right-to-left).

a11y: Each radio has words ("3 stars") in a visually hidden span, so screen readers read a score, not "star, star, star".
The legend is the question; screen readers announce it when focus enters the group.
The focus ring sits on the star around the hidden radio, so keyboard users see where they are.

examples.title: Visit feedback
examples.description: Four stars chosen; use the arrow keys or hover to change it.
